scope_line: Scope: the n8n monorepo including source-available enterprise modules (*.ee), Instance AI, chat hub, MCP, task runners and CI. n8n Cloud operations and the external template gallery are out of scope.

A1.evidence: Data tables are created in the UI with typed columns; a DDL service creates real tables without deploy, with their own permissions and public API (packages/cli/src/modules/data-table: data-table-ddl.service.ts, data-table-permissions.ts; packages/cli/src/public-api/v1/handlers/data-tables).
A1.alt_note: Data tables are storage for workflows, not general business-object types with forms and relations.

A2.evidence: Data-table columns are typed (data-table-column.entity.ts); execution data has redaction policies (packages/cli/src/modules/redaction/redaction-policy.ts) but no field-level privacy classification.
A2.alt_note: Redaction policies are a consumed privacy control, though not a field tag.

A3.evidence: No declarable relations between data tables and no lifecycle states for user entities; workflow states are product-defined.

B1.evidence: One generic rows API serves every data table (public-api/v1/handlers/data-tables); the rest of the API is hand-written per resource.
B1.alt_note: Every defined entity type (data table) gets API presence without per-entity code.

B2.evidence: Creating or altering a data table changes the rows API immediately, and each workflow exposed over MCP or webhooks changes the callable surface without a deploy.

B3.evidence: Public API v1 with an OpenAPI description and structured validation errors (packages/cli/src/public-api/index.ts, public-api-validation-error.ts); no typed client generation or dry-run.
B3.alt_note: Shared API types package (packages/@n8n/api-types) serves typed clients internally.

C1.evidence: Workflow canvases and Form trigger pages are stored as data and can be tested before activation (packages/nodes-base/nodes/Form); application layout is code.
C1.alt_note: Forms are admin-authored, validated and previewable layouts.

C2.evidence: Generic grid for any data table and generic form rendering from field definitions; no configurable list and detail views for other objects.

C3.evidence: UI strings externalised in an i18n package with community locales (33 locale files); no tenant theme editor or text overrides.

D1.evidence: Workflows are machine-readable rules (triggers, If, Switch, Filter and 400+ action nodes) composed in the UI across all integrations and data tables; testable with pinned data and by debugging past executions; versioned in workflow history (packages/cli/src/workflows/workflow-history); authored by the AI workflow builder and Instance AI (packages/@n8n/ai-workflow-builder.ee, packages/@n8n/instance-ai).
D1.alt_note: If replaying a past execution does not count as simulation against history.

D2.evidence: Event bus with log-streaming destinations (webhook, syslog, Sentry) configured by admins (packages/cli/src/modules/log-streaming.ee, packages/workflow/src/message-event-bus.ts); webhook triggers; executions are logged and can be retried.

D3.evidence: Code nodes run in separate task-runner processes with memory, payload, concurrency and time limits (packages/@n8n/config/src/configs/runners.config.ts:36-55) and module allowlists (packages/@n8n/task-runner/src/config/js-runner-config.ts:5-8), triggered by events and webhooks. No egress control found.
D3.alt_note: Every clause except egress control is met.

E1.evidence: Design-system components and axe-core scanning through a Playwright fixture (packages/testing/playwright/fixtures/a11y.ts) used by a few E2E tests.
E1.alt_note: The scans run in PR E2E jobs, but cover only a few pages.

E2.evidence: Audit events for users, workflows and credentials on the event bus, exported through log streaming; policy decisions are audited (packages/cli/src/modules/policy-infrastructure/policy-decision-audit.ts); workflow review activity is recorded (workflow-review-activity.service.ts); execution pruning sets retention.
E2.alt_note: Coverage across every entity and an in-product audit viewer were not verified.

E3.evidence: Redaction policies for execution data (packages/cli/src/modules/redaction) and execution pruning; no data-subject export or tag-driven erasure.

E4.evidence: Scope-based permissions (packages/@n8n/permissions), admin type-availability policies enforced at save, publish, start and import (packages/cli/src/modules/type-availability-policies/README.md), community package scanning (packages/@n8n/scan-community-package), and security jobs on pull requests (.github/workflows/ci-pull-requests.yml:499, sec-ci-reusable.yml, security-trivy-scan-callable.yml).

F1.evidence: Workflow history with versions and restore (packages/cli/src/workflows/workflow-history); other surfaces (credentials, variables, data tables, settings) roll back only through source control.
F1.alt_note: Workflows are the main customisation surface and have full history and restore.

F2.evidence: Workflow review requests with an inbox, decision policy and a publish guard that blocks publishing until approved (packages/cli/src/modules/workflow-reviews.ee, workflow-review-publish-guard.service.ts:11-29); git-backed environments let changes be staged on another instance first (packages/cli/src/modules/source-control.ee).

F3.evidence: Shared policy infrastructure runs registered @PolicyCheck classes at fixed points with cleared or blocked outcomes and audited decisions (packages/cli/src/modules/policy-infrastructure/README.md); review decision policy (workflow-review-decision-policy.ts).

F4.evidence: Nodes are versioned so existing workflows keep their typeVersion; a breaking-changes module scans workflows and configuration against the target version with a rule registry and migration services (packages/cli/src/modules/breaking-changes/README.md); node engine compatibility checks (packages/@n8n/node-engine-compatibility).
F4.alt_note: If migrations are applied rather than proposed, or breaking changes lack a policy exception.

G1.evidence: Data tables are real database tables queried with SQL; a workflow index supports search (packages/cli/src/modules/workflow-index); no definition-driven index mapping.

G2.evidence: One instance per customer with projects inside it; concurrency limits and queue mode with workers; no per-tenant noisy-neighbour detection.

G3.evidence: Performance E2E runs on pull requests (ci-pull-requests.yml:492, test-e2e-performance-reusable.yml) and nightly benchmarks (test-benchmark-nightly.yml, packages/@n8n/benchmark); per-surface limits not documented in the repository.
G3.alt_note: A performance suite gates pull requests; only documented limits are missing.

H1.evidence: Main, worker, webhook and task-runner processes ship as separate container images from one monorepo build (12 Dockerfiles).

H2.evidence: pnpm workspace packages, a module system with explicit registration, and import restrictions in package lint configs (packages/cli/eslint.config.mjs); Playwright architecture enforced by janitor (packages/testing/janitor).
H2.alt_note: Lint-enforced boundaries plus API types between packages.

H3.evidence: Pull requests run unit, lint, E2E (including axe fixtures), database, smoke, frontend declaration, performance and security jobs with no draft filter (.github/workflows/ci-pull-requests.yml:280-508).

I1.evidence: Declarative and programmatic custom nodes, community packages installed from the UI (packages/cli/src/modules/community-packages), frontend extension SDK (packages/@n8n/extension-sdk), workflow templates and agent tools.
I1.alt_note: Theme and text are not plugin points.

I2.evidence: User code runs in isolated task-runner processes with resource limits; community nodes are scanned and can be restricted by policy but run with full trust in the main process.
I2.alt_note: Code-node isolation meets every clause except egress.

I3.evidence: Node CLI with dev server and linting (packages/@n8n/node-cli, eslint-plugin-community-nodes), source-control branches, execution logs and pinned-data testing against a live instance.

K1.evidence: Instance MCP server with scoped API keys, per-workflow tool availability and MCP evaluations (packages/cli/src/modules/mcp: mcp-scopes.ts, mcp-tool-availability.ts, evaluations).
K1.alt_note: Each exposed workflow becomes a tool whose schema comes from its trigger definition.

K2.evidence: Instance AI gives a natural-language interface to workflows, executions, credentials and nodes, with plans and approval cards before execution (packages/@n8n/instance-ai/docs/architecture.md, tools.md:18-82); chat hub for members (packages/cli/src/modules/chat-hub); Instance AI evaluations run in CI (.github/workflows/ci-instance-ai-evals.yml).
K2.alt_note: Instance AI aims to make workflows reachable without the UI and is evaluated in CI.

K3.evidence: Scoped API keys and MCP scopes, approval cards for AI actions, policy checks and audit events; no idempotency keys or dry-run for API mutations.
K3.alt_note: Manual test executions with pinned data act as a dry-run for workflows.

N1.evidence: All connectors exchange a common item format and are joined by configurable mapping (expressions and field mapping in the UI), so a second system is mapping configuration (packages/workflow).
N1.alt_note: No canonical domain model, only a canonical transport format.

N2.evidence: Node SDK with credential types for auth, trigger and polling patterns and versioning (packages/@n8n/create-node, packages/@n8n/node-cli); admins install community connectors in the UI.
N2.alt_note: Verified community nodes amount to certification.

N3.evidence: Path-versioned public API (packages/cli/src/public-api/v1) with documented breaking changes (packages/cli/BREAKING-CHANGES.md); no deprecation windows.

O1.evidence: Kernel of users and SSO, projects and roles, workflows, credentials, executions, data tables, chat and triggers from any channel; no business-domain nouns in core.
O1.alt_note: Kernel primitives are not themselves configurable definitions, so 4 is a stretch.

O2.evidence: New domains are expressible as workflows, credentials and data tables with no kernel change, but no domain shipped this way is evidenced inside the repository.
O2.alt_note: The public template gallery (grade C) proves many domains.

O3.evidence: Workflows export and import as JSON; source control pushes and pulls workflows, credential stubs, variables and tags between instances.
O3.alt_note: A source-control branch is a versioned, installable bundle.

J1.evidence: The insights module collects execution counts, failures and time saved continuously and shows them in the product (packages/cli/src/modules/insights); vendor telemetry with redaction (packages/@n8n/telemetry).

J2.evidence: Evaluation test runs record metrics per workflow (packages/@n8n/db/src/entities/test-run.ee.ts) and insights record per-workflow outcomes; no triage workflow.
J2.alt_note: Test runs are linked to the workflow they evaluate.

J3.evidence: Insights cover executions only; nothing joins usage, support and delivery data.

M1.evidence: The breaking-changes detection report recommends fixes before upgrades (packages/cli/src/modules/breaking-changes/detection-report.ts): evidence-backed recommendations for one area.

M3.evidence: AI workflow builder and Instance AI turn requests into workflow changes behind approvals, per instance.
M3.alt_note: The lane is broad and governed, not narrow and engineer-run.

M4.evidence: Evaluations run workflows over datasets and record metrics per test run (packages/cli/src/evaluation.ee, test-run.ee entity); agent evals rate agents (packages/cli/src/modules/agent-evals). Runs are not bound to a keep, revise or rollback decision.
M4.alt_note: Test runs give a baseline and metric per workflow version.

L1.evidence: /healthz and /healthz/readiness (packages/cli/src/abstract-server.ts:139), Prometheus metrics (server.ts:172), instance version history (packages/cli/src/modules/instance-version-history) and settings APIs exposing configuration.
L1.alt_note: If the settings API is not a deployed-configuration snapshot.

L2.evidence: One preview codespace per pull request from the master prebuild (scripts/codespace-preview/preview.mjs), instance seeding scripts (scripts/instance-seeding), nightly benchmark infrastructure created and destroyed (test-benchmark-destroy-nightly.yml).

L3.evidence: Playwright journeys (packages/testing/playwright/composables/journeys) with nightly coverage; no changed-path to journey map or adoption instrumentation at ship evidenced.
L3.alt_note: Telemetry instruments features; janitor enforces test architecture.

P1.evidence: The AI workflow builder and Instance AI change workflows when asked; nothing learns from runs without being asked.
P1.alt_note: Insights capture experience that the AI can read on request.

P2.evidence: Evaluations can compare a workflow version against a dataset before publishing (packages/cli/src/evaluation.ee), but they are run by people and are not tied to the publish decision.
P2.alt_note: If evaluations plus the review publish guard count as a pass or block decision.

limits: Repository evidence only, master at the tip named above. Enterprise modules (*.ee) are included; they need a licence to run. n8n Cloud operations, the template gallery and community-node certification processes are outside the repository. Single rater.
reading: **Strongest:** Governance (2.8), the best in the sample. Workflow reviews block publishing until approved, a shared policy engine audits decisions, admins set type-availability policies, and a breaking-changes module keeps workflows working across upgrades (F2 3, F3 3, F4 4). Workflows are machine-readable, versioned and AI-authored rules (D1 4). **Largest gap:** Learning (1.8). Nothing learns from runs without being asked (P1 1), and evaluations are not tied to the publish decision (P2 2), so the measure stage of the closed loop fails.
